brief:
Two babies died in a fire that swept through a displacement tent in Gaza, Zeteo reported. The incident occurred as the UN issued warnings about the humanitarian crisis deepening ahead of winter months in the territory.

Hundreds of thousands of Palestinians are sheltering in makeshift camps across Gaza after displacement forced them from their homes. The UN alert flagged risks to vulnerable populations—including children, the elderly, and the sick—as colder weather and winter rains compound existing shortages of food, water, and medical supplies.
dek: Zeteo’s weekly round-up of the stories you may have missed out of occupied Gaza and the West Bank, as Israel continues its genocidal war and apartheid policies.
title: Two Gaza infants die in tent fire as winter approaches
